verdict.rationale: Aleph documents versioned forecasts with variance analysis, budget planning and tracking, and a connector library that covers CRM and billing systems. Together these support building a plan from pipeline or subscription data and comparing it to actuals. However, no evidence describes a dedicated revenue-planning workflow, so the revenue-specific depth is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit revenue-plan capability driven by CRM pipeline or subscription/billing data, documented plan-vs-actuals revenue tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can build a revenue plan from CRM pipeline or subscription data and track it against actuals

citations.quote: Versioned forecasts, scenario modeling, and board-ready variance analysis.
